privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.hero_desc: At Vivu, your personal data's safety is our top priority. We protect your information as we protect our most precious heritage.

sections.collection_desc: We collect the following information to ensure your journey goes smoothly:

collection_items.id_desc: Full name, date of birth, ID/Passport number when booking.
collection_items.contact_desc: Email address, phone number, billing address.
collection_items.payment_desc: Transaction details (we do not store credit card numbers).
collection_items.device_desc: IP address, browser type, operating system.

sections.usage_desc: Vivu uses your information for the following transparent purposes:
usage_items: Confirm and manage travel booking requests.
Send update notifications about journeys and service changes.
Improve user experience on the Vivu platform.
Prevent fraudulent activities and ensure system safety.
sections.sharing_partner_desc: Hotel and airline partners to complete your booking.
sections.sharing_payment_desc: Secure payment gateways for financial transactions.
sections.sharing_legal_desc: When required by competent authorities under applicable law.

privacy.safecare: Your data is encrypted using military-grade AES-256 standard.
privacy.security_commitment_desc: Information safety is at the heart of Vivu. We apply advanced technical measures to protect customer data.
privacy.security_ssl_desc: All data transfers are protected with 256-bit SSL certificates.
privacy.security_access_desc: Only authorized staff can access your personal information.
privacy.cookies_intro: We use cookies to personalize your experience and analyze website traffic.
privacy.cookie_essential_desc: Required for navigation and security features of the website.
privacy.cookie_performance_desc: Collect information on how customers use the site to help us improve services.
privacy.cookie_functional_desc: Allow the site to remember your choices (such as language or region).
privacy.sharing_intro: Vivu does not sell your data. We only share information when necessary:
privacy.rights_intro: You always retain full control over your data:
privacy.right_access_desc: You may request to review all information we store about you.
privacy.right_edit_desc: Request updates if information is inaccurate or outdated.
privacy.right_delete_desc: You may request permanent deletion of personal data in specific cases.
privacy.contact_intro: If you have any questions about this policy, contact our security team:
privacy.contact_address: 12F, Heritage Building, 123 Le Loi, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.hero_desc: Please read these terms carefully before using Vivu's services to understand your rights and responsibilities.
terms.intro_p1: Welcome to Vivu. By accessing our website or using any services we provide, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service.
terms.intro_p2: Vivu is an online travel platform offering tour, hotel and cultural experience bookings in Vietnam. We are committed to authentic heritage value through transparency and safety.
terms.def_service_desc: All travel products including tours, accommodation and attraction tickets on the Vivu system.
terms.def_member_desc: An individual or organization that has successfully registered an account on our platform.
terms.accounts_p1: To use certain features, you must register an account. You are responsible for securing your login credentials and all activity under your account.
accounts_items: Information provided must be accurate and kept up to date.
You may not transfer your account to any third party.
Notify Vivu immediately if you detect unauthorized access.
terms.bookings_pricing: Prices are listed publicly and include basic taxes and fees unless otherwise noted.
terms.bookings_payment_desc: Vivu uses high-grade encryption. All transactions are protected by Vivu SafeCare so third parties cannot access your card information.
terms.cancellation_intro: Refund policy depends on the service type and cancellation timing.
terms.privacy_p1: Vivu is committed to protecting your personal information to the highest security standards. Data collection and use are fully transparent.
terms.privacy_measure_ssl_desc: All connections between your browser and our servers are fully encrypted.
terms.privacy_measure_access_desc: Only authorized staff can access user personal information.
terms.privacy_measure_backup_desc: Data is backed up periodically to prevent loss in any situation.
terms.privacy_measure_audit_desc: The system is periodically audited by independent security experts.
terms.privacy_link_prefix: For more details on how we collect and process personal data, please see
terms.ip_p1: All content on the Vivu platform including text, images, logos, icons, video and software is the exclusive intellectual property of Vivu or its licensors.

ip_rules.text: Personal, non-commercial use with clear attribution.
Sharing links to pages on the Vivu website.
Copying, distributing or modifying content for commercial purposes.
Using the Vivu logo or brand without written consent.

terms.ip_p2: Any copyright infringement will be handled under Vietnamese law and international intellectual property conventions.
